title: Venus of Hohle Fels
summary: A small carved figure of a woman, the oldest known carved figure of a human.
why: One of the oldest known images of the human body, carved in the round.

notes.problem: Cited timeline says 'oldest known'; the figure's own page says 'oldest undisputed example of a depiction of a human being' (older claims exist).
'Oldest undisputed depiction of a human' conflicts with the catalog's own 51,200-year Sulawesi human-like figures; source says 'oldest known figurative art of a human figure'.
